name: Paperclip Bridge
description: Lets OpenClaw agents report progress, post comments, and create issues in Paperclip without writing raw fetch boilerplate. Pairs with paperclip-plugin-openclaw-bridge on the Paperclip side.

baseUrl.label: Paperclip Base URL
baseUrl.help: Where to reach the Paperclip API. Default: http://127.0.0.1:3100

apiKey.label: Paperclip API Key
apiKey.help: Long-lived Paperclip agent API key. The paperclip-plugin-openclaw-bridge's 'Bootstrap PC credentials' button generates one per agent; paste the value that corresponds to THIS OpenClaw instance.

defaultCompanyId.label: Default Company ID
defaultCompanyId.help: If set, paperclip.* tool calls that don't pass companyId use this. Saves the agent from having to know it.

defaultAgentId.label: Default Agent ID
defaultAgentId.help: If set, the tool tags activity as coming from this Paperclip agent.
